steps.title: Plans
steps.expect: `ERRORS: 0`; the ready tasks of the lowest open milestone.

steps.title: package.json and workflow pins
steps.expect: Silent, exit 0. A `^1.0.0` range, `@velexis/testing` in `dependencies` or an unpinned `uses:` prints one line each and exits 1.

steps.title: No hard-coded hosts
steps.expect: Exit 0; otherwise file:line:column of each `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `:5432`, `:6379` in app/package code.

steps.title: Tests of the tools
steps.body: `pnpm exec eslint tools/ci tools/perf guidebook && node --test tools/ci/*.test.mjs tools/perf/*.test.mjs guidebook/tools/guidebook.test.mjs tools/dev/dev-keys.test.mjs` and `node --test tools/plan-lint/test/` (CI's build-test runs the lint and the first three test sets in its step "Lint and test the CI checks, tools/perf and the guidebook"; its dev-setup job runs `tools/dev/dev-keys.test.mjs`).
steps.expect: All pass; they write only to the system temporary folder.
